title: Sources: Anthropic's IPO is ~7x oversubscribed; Anthropic and some of its backers are seeking to raise up to $90.4B via the IPO and a separate private placement (Bloomberg)
summary: Bloomberg: Sources: Anthropic's IPO is ~7x oversubscribed; Anthropic and some of its backers are seeking to raise up to $90.4B via the IPO and a separate private placement — The startup is set for the biggest IPO of all time, putting AI investors' hopes and dreams — and fears — onto a frontier model maker.
